```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class BookmarkForm extends Component
{
    public $bookmark = null;

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.bookmark-form');
    }

    public function saveBookmark()
    {
        // Logic to save the bookmark
        $user = Auth::user();
        $newBookmark = new \App\Models\Bookmark($this->bookmark);
        $newBookmark->save();

        $this->bookmark = null; // Clear the form data after saving

        session()->flash('success', 'Bookmark saved successfully!');
    }

    public function deleteBookmark()
    {
        // Logic to delete the bookmark
        $user = Auth::user();
        $bookmark = \App\Models\Bookmark::find($this->bookmark['id']);
        $bookmark->delete();

        session()->flash('success', 'Bookmark deleted successfully!');
    }
}
```
